name: Pergolide

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in United States and Canada, first in 2007 — for heart harm

summary: Pergolide was removed from the market in the United States and Canada starting in 2007 due to heart harm [3]. A small computer model, rather than tests on people, gave the drug a low risk score of 37 for liver issues [M]. The same computer model also gave the drug a medium risk score of 58 for heart problems instead of evaluating human patients [M].
